profiles.name: Chang Lih Kang
profiles.position: Minister of Science, Technology and Innovation
profiles.description: Chang Lih Kang is Minister of Science, Technology and Innovation. He represents Tanjong Malim, Perak, in the Dewan Rakyat. He is a member of Parti Keadilan Rakyat (PKR).

profiles.name: Nancy Shukri
profiles.position: Minister of Women, Family and Community Development
profiles.description: Nancy Shukri is Minister of Women, Family and Community Development. She represents Santubong, Sarawak, in the Dewan Rakyat. She is a member of Parti Pesaka Bumiputera Bersatu (PBB).

milestones.title: Raise R&D spending to at least 2.5% of GDP by 2030 under DSTIN
milestones.description: MOSTI’s release, quoting Chang on strengthening research, commits to the DSTIN 2021–2030 spending floor of at least 2.5% of GDP by 2030.
milestones.progress_note: The release lists active research-funding and commercialisation initiatives and a 2022 GERD baseline of 1.01%. It separately mentions a broader 3.5% MADANI ambition. This record tracks the explicitly dated DSTIN floor; neither figure is a completion score or a current spending result.

milestones.title: Support mammogram screening for 38,000 women under Budget 2027
milestones.description: Nancy said the Budget 2027 mammogram subsidy allocation was expected to benefit 38,000 women.
milestones.progress_note: The report establishes the 2027 target and allocation, not delivery to those 38,000 women. Cumulative screenings since 2007 are not this target’s outcome. Completion and status remain unknown.

methodology: Editorial records of attributable commitments and dated evidence, not endorsements or independently audited performance scores. Promise dates use explicitly stated event dates where available. Year/month-only target dates use end-of-period markers, not an invented exact-day promise. Sector ratios, budget allocations and announcements are not completion scores.
